expectations.text: Project path uses hierarchical pattern workspaces/{workspace}/projects/{project}
expectations.evidence: only listProjects/createProject use hierarchical path; get/update/delete use flat /projects/{id}
list/create use /projects/{projectId}/tasks but get/update/delete use flat /tasks/{id}

expectations.text: Collection identifiers (workspaces, projects, tasks) are lowercase plural camelCase
expectations.evidence: workspaces, projects, tasks all lowercase plural

expectations.text: Update procedure uses HTTP PATCH (not PUT)
List input uses pageSize/pageToken cursor pagination (not offset/limit)
expectations.evidence: PaginationInput uses 'limit' and 'cursor' fields at lines 28-31

expectations.text: Status enum has a *_UNSPECIFIED zero-value member
Priority enum has a *_UNSPECIFIED zero-value member
Enum members use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g. IN_PROGRESS, not in-progress)
Project and Task schemas expose a `name: string` field as canonical identifier
expectations.evidence: schemas use `id: Id` (a string) but field name is 'id' not 'name'; uses workspaceId/projectId tuple

expectations.text: Task does NOT embed Project as a nested object (references by name string instead)
expectations.evidence: projectId: Id field, not embedded Project object

expectations.text: Update input supports partial fields + updateMask (not full resource replace)
expectations.evidence: UpdateProjectInput/UpdateTaskInput have optional fields (partial-like) but no updateMask

expectations.text: List/create inputs include a `parent` string field for the parent resource
expectations.evidence: uses 'workspaceId' and 'projectId' fields, not a 'parent' string
